verses: Alif Laam Meem
Yeh hikmat wali kitab ki aayaten hain
Jo neko kaaron kay liye rehbar aur (sirasir) rehmat hai
Jo log namaz qaeem kertay hain aur zakat ada kertay hain aur aakhirat per (kamil) yaqeen rakhtay hain
Yehi log hain jo apney rab ki taraf say hidayat per hain aur yehi log nijat paney walay hain

Aur baaz log aisay bhi hain jo laghaw baaton ko mol letay hain kay bey-ilmi kay sath logon ko Allah ki raah say behkayen aur ussay hansi banayen, yehi woh log hain jin kay liye ruswa kerney wala azab hai

Jab uss kay samney humari aayaten tilawat ki jati hain to takabbur kerta hua uss tarah mun pher leta hai goya uss ney suna hi nahi goya kay uss kay dono kanon mein daat lagay huye hain, aap ussay dard naak azab ki khabar suna dijiye
Be-shak jin logon eman qabool kiya aur kaam bhi nek (mutabiq sunnat) kiye unn kay liye nematon wali jannaten hain
Jahan woh hamesha rahen gay. Allah ka sacha wada hai, woh boht bari izzat o ghalba wala aur kamil hikmat wala hai

Ussi ney aasmano ko baghair sutoon kay peda kiya hai tum unhen dekh rahey ho aur uss ney zamin mein paharon ko daal diya takay woh tumhen junbish na dey sakay aur her tarah kay jaandaar zamin mein phela diye. Aur hum ney aasman say pani barsa ker zamin mein her qasam kay nafees joray uga diye
Yeh hai Allah ki makhlooq abb tum mujhay uss kay siwa doosray kissi ki koi makhlooq to dikhao (kuch nahi), balkay)yeh yeh zalim khulli gumrahi mein hain

Aur hum ney yaqeenan luqman ko hikmat di thi kay to Allah Taalaa ka shukar ker her shukar kerney wala apney hi nafa kay liye shukar kerta hai jo bhi na-shukri keray woh jaan ley kay Allah Taalaa bey niaz aur tareefon wala hai
Aur jab kay luqman ney waaz kehtay huye apney larkay say farmaya kay meray piyaray bachay! Allah kay sath shareek na kerna be-shak shirk bara bhari zulm hai

Hum ney insan ko uss kay maa baap kay mutalliq naseehat ki hai, uss ki maa ney dukh per dukh utha ker ussay hamal mein rakha aur uss ki doodh chraee do baras mein hai kay to meri aur apney maa baap ki shukar guzari ker, (tum sab ko) meri hi taraf lot ker aana hai

Aur agar woh dono tujh per uss baat ka dabao dalen kay to meray sath shareek keray jiss ka tujhay ilm na ho to to unn ka kehna na manna, haan duniya mein unn kay sath achi tarah basar kerna aur uss ki raah chalna jo meri taraf jhuka hua ho tumhara sab ka lotna meri hi taraf hai tum jo kuch kertay ho uss say phir mein tumhen khabardaar keroon ga

Piyaray betay! agar koi cheez raaee kay daney kay barabar ho phir woh (bhi) khuwah kissi chattaan mein ho ya aasmano mein ho ya zamin mein ho ussay Allah Taalaa zaroor laye ga Allah Taalaa bara bareek been aur khabardaar hai

Aey meray piyaray betay! to namaz qaeem rakhna, achay kaamon ki naseehat kertay rehna, buray kaamon say mana kiya kerna aur jo museebat tum per aajaye sabar kerna (yaqeen mano) kay yeh baray takeedi kaamon mein say hai
Logon kay samney apney gaal na phula aur zamin per itra ker na chal kissi takabbur kerney walay shekhi khoray ko Allah Taalaa pasand nahi farmata
Apni raftar mein miyana ravi ikhtiyar ker, aur apni awaz pust ker yaqeenan awazon mein sab say badtar awaz gadhon ki awaz hai

Kiya tum nahi dekhtay kay Allah Taalaa ney zamin o aasman ki her cheez ko humaray kaam mein laga rakha hai aur tumhen apni zahiri o baatini nematen bharpoor dey rakhi hain, baaz log Allah kay baray mein baghair ilm kay aur baghair hidayat kay aur baghair roshan kitab kay jhagra kertay hain

Aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay Allah Taalaa ki utari hui wahee ki tabeydaari kero to kehtay hain kay hum ney to jiss tareeq per apney baap dadon ko paya hai ussi ki tabeydaari keren gay, agarcheh shetan unn kay baron ko dozakh azab ki taraf bulata ho
Aur jo (shakhs) apney aap ko Allah kay tabey kerdey aur ho bhi woh neko kaar yaqeenan uss ney mazboot kara thaam liya, tamam kaamon ka anjam Allah ki taraf hai
Kafiron kay kufur say aap ranjeedah na hun, aakhir unn sab ko lotna to humari janib hi hai phir hum unn ko batayen gay jo unhon ney kiya hai, bey shak Allah seenon kay bhedon tak say waqif hai
Hum unhen go kuch yunhi sa faeedah dey den lekin (bil-aakhir) hum unhen nihayat chaargi ki halat mein sakht azab ki taraf hanka ley jayen gay

Agar aap unn say daryaft keren kay aasman o zamin ka khaliq kaun hai? To yeh zaroor jawab den gay kay Allah, to keh dijiye kay sab tareefon kay laeeq Allah hi hai, lekin unn mein kay aksar bey ilm hain
Aasmano mein aur zamin mein jo kuch hai woh sab Allah hi ka hai yaqeenan Allah Taalaa boht bara bey niaz aur sazawaar hamd o sana hai

Aur zamin kay (tamam) darakhton kay agar qalamen ho jayen aur tamam samandaron ki siyahi ho aur unn kay baad saat samandar aur hun tahum Allah kay kalmaat khatam nahi ho saktay, be-shak Allah Taalaa ghalib aur ba-hikmat hai
Tum sab ki pedaeesh aur marney kay baad jalana aisa hi hai jaisay aik ji ka, be-shak Allah Taalaa sunnay wala dekhney wala hai

Kiya aap nahi dekhtay kay Allah Taalaa raat ko din mein aur din ko raat mein khapa deta hai, sooraj chand ko ussi ney farman bardaar ker rakha hai her aik muqarrara waqt tak chalta rahey, Allah Taalaa her uss cheez say jo tum kertay ho khabardaar hai
Yeh sab (intizamaat) uss wajah say hain kay Allah Taalaa haq hai aur uss kay siwa jin jin ko log pukartay hain sab baatil hain aur yaqeenan Allah Taalaa boht bulandiyon wala aur bari shaan wala hai

Kiya tum uss per ghor nahi kertay kay darya mein kashtiyan Allah kay fazal say chal rahi hain uss liye kay woh tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhaway, yaqeenan uss mein her aik sabar o shukar kerney walay kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain

Aur jab unn per mojen sayebanon ki tarah cha jati hain to woh (nihayat) khuloos kay sath aetiqaad ker kay Allah Taalaa hi ko pukartay hain. Phir jab woh (bari Taalaa) unhen nijat dey ker khushki ki taraf phonchata hai to kuch unn mein say aeytidaal per rehtay hain, aur humari aayaton ka inkar sirf o hi kertay hain jo bad-ehad aur na-shukray hun

Logo! apney rab say daro aur uss din ka khof kero jiss din baap apney betay ko koi nafa na phoncha sakay ga aur na beta apney baap ka zara sa bhi nafa kerney wala hoga (yaad rakho) Allah ka wada sacha hai (dekho) tumhen duniya ki zindagi dhokay mein na dalay aur na dhokay baaz (shetan) tumhen dhokay mein daal dey

Bey shak Allah Taalaa hi kay pass qayamat ka ilm hai o hi barish nazil farmata hai aur maa kay pet mein jo hai ussay janta hai. Koi (bhi) nahi janta kay kul kiya (kuch) keray ga? Na kissi ko yeh maloom hai kay kiss zamin mein maray ga. (yaad rakho) Allah Taalaa hi pooray ilm wala aur sahih khabron wala hai
